name: @vhyxvoid/sdk
description: Frontend TypeScript SDK — connect to your backend through the platform tunnel

scripts.build: rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc -b && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:@vhyxvoid/protocol=../protocol/src/index.ts --external:ws --external:isomorphic-ws --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:@vhyxvoid/protocol=../protocol/src/index.ts --external:ws --external:isomorphic-ws --outfile=dist/index.mjs && node ../../scripts/check-dist.mjs dist/index.js dist/index.mjs
